notes.zh-CN:
- 升级原版 Dlssg_for_sm86 至 0.4.2，保留上游默认配置；已有安装升级时保留参数，卸载重装恢复新默认值。
- 新增 ANR FG V.B15 完整方案，自动安装所需模型与组件。DX12 通常选择 dxgi.dll，Vulkan 选择 winmm.dll，每次只使用一个入口。
- 支持 ANR 参数设置、玩家分享及卸载清理；遇到已有 OptiScaler 或其他同名文件时提示冲突，避免覆盖。ANR FG 不等于 NVIDIA DLSS 神经渲染。
- 保留三角洲 0.4.1 6X、旧三角洲 0.3.5、MFG 和 Encore 方案。Windows 与 Linux 安装包同步提供，更新通道保持独立。
notes.en:
- Update standard Dlssg_for_sm86 to 0.4.2 with upstream defaults. Supported upgrades preserve settings; uninstalling and reinstalling restores current defaults.
- Add the ANR FG V.B15 full package with its models and components. Normally use dxgi.dll for DX12 or winmm.dll for Vulkan, with one entry at a time.
- Add ANR settings, shared presets and owned-file cleanup. Existing OptiScaler installations or file conflicts are protected from replacement. ANR FG is separate from NVIDIA DLSS Neural Rendering.
- Keep custom Delta Force 0.4.1 6X, legacy custom 0.3.5, MFG and Encore schemes. Windows and Linux packages remain on separate update channels.
